decisions.GW: Retain G4 as the minimal practical GW baseline, but classify groundwater event/reversal fidelity as unresolved because B01 is EVENT_SENSITIVE while B14 is relatively robust.
decisions.SM: Retain S4 as the minimal practical SM baseline. It is relatively robust against U4 on both exposed development materials with no storage-extremum timing mismatch.
decisions.performance: Retain 4/6/8-state Layer-ROM cost evidence as a strong shared-host reduction signal only. Direct purpose-specific S4/G4 timing remains required.
decisions.targeted_repair: Do not repair yet. First execute a fresh practical dynamic panel spanning recharge, capillary rise, shallow/deep groundwater and forcing reversals. Repair only if the same dominant GW event defect recurs.
decisions.ET: Remain closed until GW and SM fresh-panel characterization.

next_work_unit.purpose: Fresh dynamic practical panel and direct purpose-specific timing
requirements: Freeze development and blind histories before candidate response.
Use at least four hydraulically contrasting materials beyond the P2 two-material panel.
Include daily forcing, shallow/deep groundwater, recharge/capillary-rise/reversal regimes and seasonal windows.
Run S4/G4 first; add S6/S8 or G6/G8 only under the frozen ladder, not by case tuning.
Measure direct wall-clock and CPU time for S4/G4 and Reference in identical CI context.
Attempt MetaSWAP only if executable/data provenance is reproducible.
